pages: Total net sales were $1,577 million in fiscal 2023, an increase of 12% over 2022. Growth was broad-based across segments and regions.
Operating income was $245 million and net income was $190 million. Capital expenditures totalled $80 million in fiscal 2023.
Cash and cash equivalents were $410 million at year end. Long-term debt was $1,200 million at year end.
Subscription revenue grew while hardware revenue declined during 2022 across every region.
Goodwill impairment testing found no impairment in any reporting segment this year.
The audit committee reviewed the internal control framework with management and the auditors.
